Round139F.genuine_coefficient_functional_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) (μ : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (hμ : μ Set.univ ≠ 0) (α : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (χ : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (z : ℂ)
  (m : ℕ) (hstrip : |z.re| ≤ α) (hmd : m < d)
  (hg :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => MasulloGRH.genuineSpectralJet K χ z m x / ↑√(MasulloGRH.genuineStripWeight K α d x))
      μ) :
  ∃ V η,
    0 < V ∧
      μ (MasulloGRH.genuineClassLogReal K ⁻¹' Set.Ioc 0 1) = ↑V ∧
        (∀ (f : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 μ)),
            η f =
              ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                MasulloGRH.genuineSpectralJet K χ z m x / ↑√(MasulloGRH.genuineStripWeight K α d x) * ↑↑f x ∂μ) ∧
          ‖η‖ ^ 2 ≤ ↑V * ∫ (t : ℝ), (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹
